package com.synexia.mindex;

/** Stable coarse kind for a namespace in the hierarchical MIndex lexicon space. */
public enum MIndexLexiconKind {
    ROOT,
    LANGUAGE_STANDARD,
    PROPER_NOUN,
    PERSON_GIVEN,
    PERSON_FAMILY,
    ORGANIZATION,
    PRODUCT,
    BRAND,
    GEOGRAPHIC,
    COUNTRY,
    REGION,
    CITY,
    STREET,
    LANDMARK,
    ACRONYM,
    ABBREVIATION,
    TITLE,
    SCIENTIFIC,
    MATHEMATICAL_SYMBOL,
    MATHEMATICAL_EQUATION,
    PHYSICS_SYMBOL,
    CHEMICAL_FORMULA,
    TECHNICAL,
    EXPRESSION,
    EMOJI,
    PUNCTUATION,
    WHITESPACE,
    DOMAIN,
    DYNAMIC_LITERAL,
    CUSTOM
}
